Title: Generally Available: Inbound IP restrictions for Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps now supports restricting inbound traffic by IP addresses. 

This feature enables container apps to restrict inbound HTTP or TCP traffic by allowing or denying access to a specific list of IP address ranges.

Learn more.
